Routing notes:
- Do not assume all large east-region requests go to C; C is request/context-dependent.
- Observed C accepted:
  - Shipment + “came in through the regional office.”
  - Refund + client asking twice.
  - Invoice + “same as the ones I sent last month.”
  - Claim + paperwork scanned/not typed.
  - Claim + “let me know if anything is missing.”
- Observed C rejected:
  - Refund + “same as the ones I sent last month.”
  - Invoice + client asking twice.
  - Renewal + “second attempt, first form bounced.”
  - Refund + “no rush, but please confirm receipt.”
  - Invoice + paperwork scanned/not typed.
- Therefore, message cues cannot be mapped independently of request type. In particular, “same as last month,” “asking twice,” and “scanned, not typed” produce different outcomes by request category.
- No reliable sender-name or department rule is established. Collect more examples before choosing A/B when C is not clearly supported.
